title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – multi-year proposal for 6306-2Z C3
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer. Our current price is EUR 4.39, so your EUR 4.96 is a 13% increase. Your stated cost drivers do not explain a rise of that size.

PPI-C2815 moved from 118.8 (idx:PPI-C2815@2025-08) to 119.8 (idx:PPI-C2815@2026-08), a change of 0.84%.
LCI-C moved from 116.5 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06) to 119.6 (idx:LCI-C@2026-06), a change of 2.66%.
Our forecast fc:360020@2026-09 records a volume change of +4.2%.

As you indicated, only multi-year agreements change prices. We therefore propose the attached 24- and 36-month packages. If they exceed your authority, could you arrange an authorized pricing review? We would also welcome the owner's offer to walk us through your cost calculation.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – multi-year proposal for 6306-2Z C3
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. Please understand that our internal cost calculations are confidential and we do not arrange management meetings for standard pricing reviews. This offer represents our firm position based on current market conditions and our operational requirements. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we can accommodate your request for a 36-month contract with 45 days payment terms at a unit price of €4.90, giving a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Our offer is valid for 30 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal 4600070620 – 36-month volume agreement proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for the revised offer. Your weighted cost drivers support an increase of below 1%, not 12.5%.

The price also needs to reflect the service level. Your scorecard sc:70620@2026Q3 records on-time delivery of 85.0%. The same scorecard shows 302 ppm, twice the 150 ppm in your standard terms.

You indicated that multi-year volume agreements change prices. We therefore offer a firm 36-month commitment for 20,000 pc a year, as set out in the attached packages.

Could you also tell us which cheaper variant or stock-programme condition would let you move closer to our proposal?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Renewal 4600070620 – 36-month volume agreement proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. We have reviewed the scorecard data you provided; however, this does not impact our pricing for this specific part.

Our updated offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, for a 36-month agreement with 60 days payment terms, our best offer is €4.91 per unit.

Regarding your inquiry about cheaper variants, our technical team will gladly advise on alternative specifications. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Our current defect rate for you is about 150 ppm.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 7 days. With overtime we can deliver in 7 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – 36-month agreement for 6306-2Z C3
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for the updated offer and for the variant information. We will keep the specification unchanged for this agreement.

You indicated that multi-year volume agreements change prices. A 36-month commitment for 20,000 pc a year gives you planning security for a standard stock item. You already price 36 months below 24 months. We would like to combine that 36-month price with 90 days payment, as in your 24-month offer.

The attached packages set out this combination. If you can confirm one of them, could you make it your primary standing offer so that we can conclude the renewal promptly?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – 36-month agreement for 6306-2Z C3
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We always appreciate working with you and supporting your operations with our extensive range and reliable service.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current offer is a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

We can accommodate your request for a 36-month contract with 90 days payment terms at a unit price of €4.94. The extended payment terms carry a cost that offsets the pricing advantage of the longer contract duration. As an alternative, we offer a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Please provide binding documentation for the 20,000 pieces annual volume you mentioned. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Please note our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – 36-month agreement for 6306-2Z C3
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. 

It is always a pleasure to serve you with our broad range and high-standard service, and we look forward to continuing our great cooperation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
